blocks.text: Setting up Chrome for high volume moderation

Your browser is your primary workspace. If it is cluttered, your decision time increases. Start by creating a dedicated Chrome profile for your moderation tasks. Go to your profile icon in the top right corner, select Add, and sign in with your work credentials. This keeps your bookmarks, extensions, and history separate from your personal life.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for your Mac

Efficiency in moderation comes from keeping your hands on the keyboard. Use ⌘ + T to open a new tab quickly. If you need to jump between tabs, use ⌘ + Option + Right Arrow or ⌘ + Option + Left Arrow. To close a tab you have finished reviewing, hit ⌘ + W. These small movements save minutes every hour.

When you are deep in a queue, you do not want to stop to type out long incident reports. Hold the fn key on your Mac to dictate your notes directly into your moderation dashboard. Lazur ensures your text is clean and formatted, so you can focus on the content instead of the keyboard.

Moderation tools are often heavy on memory. If Chrome feels slow, clear your site data for specific sites. Go to Settings > Privacy and security > Site settings > View permissions and data stored across sites. Removing data for sites you no longer need helps maintain performance. If a specific tab hangs, use the Chrome Task Manager by pressing ⇧ + Esc to kill only the problematic process.
Practical tips for your daily workflow

items: Pin your most used moderation dashboards to the left side of your tab bar.
Use ⌘ + L to jump to the address bar when you need to switch URLs fast.
Disable unnecessary extensions that consume memory during high-traffic shifts.
Use ⌘ + F to search for specific keywords within long policy documents.
Enable hardware acceleration in Chrome settings to improve video playback performance.

blocks.text: How Lazur helps you stay focused

Sometimes you forget where a specific setting is in a complex dashboard. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur where a button is. Lazur will draw a circle around the target area on your screen. This saves you from hunting through deep menus when you are under a tight deadline.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur to automate my moderation decisions?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate other apps for you. It helps you work faster by dictating text, pointing at UI elements, and answering questions out loud.

faq.question: Does Chrome on Mac have a way to save time on repetitive tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. You can use Chrome profiles, keyboard shortcuts, and extensions to speed up your workflow. Lazur adds to this by letting you dictate reports and find UI elements instantly.

faq.question: Is it safe to use voice dictation for sensitive moderation work?
faq.answer: Lazur listens only while you hold the shortcut key. Audio is sent to AI providers to answer and is not stored. It is designed for professional privacy.
